leadText:
(Japanese: ポケモン4コマ大百科 Pokémon 4Koma Encyclopedia) is a created by Takahiro Yamashita. Each page of the Pokémon 4Koma Encyclopedia manga contains a cartoon depicting a Pokémon, comedically demonstrating a special ability or trait of each Pokémon. It also shows the height, weight and elemental type of each Pokémon, along with official artwork by Ken Sugimori from Generation III.

All the cartoons are presented in National Pokédex order, beginning with .
